Resolves #21590

🌿 The list can no longer say 6 for a page of 11, or nothing for a page of 2.

The examples list now counts what each group page shows. A group's number is its home examples plus the ones other groups lend it, so ten groups change (Apps 11, Trees 2, Drag & Drop 3), and a group page's line gives the same plain total. One line under the list, "121 examples in all. Some appear in more than one group.", explains why the list adds up to 141 against the headline's 121. With a filter on, the numbers count total matches and the line stays out. This builds Clio's decision on #21140 ([comment 7044472767](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767)) and reverses the home-only rule of #21130 and AC-3 of #21509. The data keeps `count` (home) and `crossCount` (borrowed) apart; only what the list and the page show changes.

Evidence: L3 (the Portal running headless from this branch and from `dev`, read at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: none; the deployed list after the next Pages rebuild is Post-Merge Validation.

Change class: capability. agent-preflight: not hosted here; the shared baseline runs in CI.

Frame critique:
- **1440 × 900:** every group shows its number and "All examples" none. The line under the list takes two lines at y 838 to 877, inside the 900 px window. In a window under about 880 px tall it falls below the rail's fold and is reached by scrolling the rail, as Julia notes.
- **Phone:** the list lives in the group sheet, so its numbers are read with the sheet open. The Platform band and the line sit below the sheet's first screen (the line at y 987 to 1006 of 844) and are reached by scrolling the sheet. The phone's closed first screen shows no list and is the same on both sides, so it is not paired here.
- Nothing overlaps or clips in the eight frames.
